snippet.title: This UNRELEASED Arcade Hockey Game Is WAY More Fun Than I Expected! | Center Ice Hockey
snippet.description:
I got the chance to check out Center Ice Hockey, an upcoming indie arcade-style hockey game for PC, and this game completely caught me by surprise!

I went into Center Ice Hockey not really knowing what to expect, but after getting on the ice and experiencing everything this game has to offer, I genuinely had an absolute blast playing it. The arcade-style hockey gameplay is incredibly fun, there are a TON of different ways to play, and I honestly walked away wanting to keep playing!

In this video, I jump into Center Ice Hockey gameplay and explore what this unreleased hockey game has to offer. From getting used to the gameplay and controls to checking out the different modes and experiencing the fast-paced arcade hockey action, this was my first real look at a game that seriously surprised me.

And one of the biggest things I'm interested in is Career Mode. If the HoodieFam enjoys Center Ice Hockey and wants to see more, I would absolutely be interested in jumping deeper into Career Mode and potentially bringing more of this game to the channel!

🏒 CENTER ICE HOCKEY – OFFICIAL STEAM STORE PAGE:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5100030/Center_Ice_Hockey/

DISCLOSURE: The developer of Center Ice Hockey provided me with an activation key so I could check out the game and share my experience. All opinions and reactions in this video are my own.

Center Ice Hockey has been developed as an indie hockey project with an old-school arcade hockey feel combined with modern features, and after my first experience with it, I'm really interested to see where this game goes.

HoodieFam, I need YOUR feedback! Would you like to see more Center Ice Hockey on the channel? Would you want me to start a Career Mode series when we come back to the game? Let me know in the comments because your feedback is going to help me decide what I do next!

If you enjoyed the video, make sure to LIKE, COMMENT, and SUBSCRIBE for more gaming content here!

I cover everything from simulators and sports games to shooters, action games, new releases, updates, and whatever else looks like a great time. The goal is always the same: enjoy gaming, keep chasing the dream, and never give up.
